propositions: Defect-seeded mutation runs in rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills execute arbitrary (potentially hostile) code without OS sandbox protection, creating filesystem safety risk
Both skills must require mutation test execution to run inside an OS sandbox (sandbox-exec on macOS, bwrap on Linux) that restricts writes outside the worktree and scratch directory
Skills must include complete, self-contained sandbox invocations with macOS heredoc profile generation and full Linux bwrap argv including --ro-bind, --dev, --proc, and capability probes
When sandbox is unavailable, mutation steps must not proceed unsandboxed; instead assert on injected seams to stub filesystem operations rather than observe real deletions
Regression test must verify both skills carry sandbox requirement and fail when requirement is removed from either file
